scope: Canonical input seam for the accepted 32-row source graph. This file is not checker input.

checker_owner.canonical_input_rule: Do not accept ready-rows.ndjson as ManifestDocument/SnapshotDocument/G0CollectorSnapshot. It is source-row evidence only.
required_producer_inputs: typed all-32 ManifestRepository rows with unknown/not-applicable states preserved
typed all-32 SnapshotRepository rows with rulesets and immutable workflow bytes
canonical snapshot bytes and CAS/raw-object bindings

mapper_owner.canonical_input_rule: Keep source joins and execution observations separate. Never map raw run counts, API heads, or partition plan jobs into actual execution rows.
fail_closed_seams: artifact run_attempt and exact archive binding
bound model.session and workload.artifact raw objects
required_producer_inputs: attempt-bound artifact rows and checkout proof observations

shared_join_contract.repository_key: exact owner/name string from fixed 32 set
shared_join_contract.source_revision_key: accepted_default_branch_sha; raw opening/closing SHA must match or row remains blocked
shared_join_contract.workload_key: repository + workload_id; never global workload ID alone
shared_join_contract.workflow_key: repository + path + revision + source_sha + exact immutable source bytes
shared_join_contract.execution_key: repository + run_id + run_attempt + event + trigger_source_sha + actual_checkout_sha
shared_join_contract.check_key: context + App ID + check_suite_id + check_run_id + provider execution key
shared_join_contract.artifact_key: repository + artifact_id + run_id + run_attempt + exact archive digest
shared_join_contract.graph_key: node/edge ID + source revision + source/target refs
shared_join_contract.unknown_rule: missing, absent, 404, churn, unrun, unproven, and not-applicable remain distinct; none is success
